gallery.filename: Charlottenbrücke 1 Havel Berlin.JPG
gallery.title: File:Charlottenbrücke 1 Havel Berlin.JPG
gallery.description: The Charlottenbrücke is a steel arch bridge in Berlin-Spandau crossing the Havel. The listed bridge is a part of the Charlotten- and Stresowstraße and situated at the eastside of Spandau's Altstadt (old town). It was built between 1926 and 1929 and replaced the old bridge dating from 1886.
